permissions.groups.submission-proof.desc: Permissions provided by the Submission Proof app.
permissions.keys.submission-proof.note.r: Synthetic test data only. Notes are shared with every tenant member granted read permission; they are not private by author or organization. Saving uses last-writer-wins and may overwrite concurrent edits. Deleted notes and history are retained indefinitely and can be restored through the authorized API; this app has no automatic purge. Do not enter personal or production data.
